body:
Repro: [https://github.com/cyrilletuzi/ngcc-cleanup](https://github.com/cyrilletuzi/ngcc-cleanup)

To reproduce:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/cyrilletuzi/ngcc-cleanup
cd ngcc-cleanup
npm run issue
```

Thx for the repro, @cyrilletuzi. It really helped the to the bottom of it more quickly 💯

So, it turns out we are not invalidating our `FileSystem` cache correctly [when moving a file][1] or [when removing a directory][2] during clean-up. I have verified the fix against your repro - PR incoming 🚀 

[1]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/4d36b2f6e/packages/compiler-cli/src/ngtsc/file_system/src/cached_file_system.ts#L73-L81
[2]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/4d36b2f6e/packages/compiler-cli/src/ngtsc/file_system/src/cached_file_system.ts#L93-L98

issue.title: fix(ngcc): correctly invalidate cache when moving/removing files/directories

issue.body:
One particular scenario where this was causing problems was when the [BackupFileCleaner][1] restored a file (such as a `.d.ts` file) by [moving the backup file][2] to its original location, but the modified content was kept in the cache.

Fixes #35095.

[1]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/4d36b2f6e/packages/compiler-cli/ngcc/src/writing/cleaning/cleaning_strategies.ts#L54
[2]: https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/4d36b2f6e/packages/compiler-cli/ngcc/src/writing/cleaning/cleaning_strategies.ts#L61
